label: Corrected method: 2025 data with errors against the thesis sources corrected
description: The 2025 data of 2025-fuel with the corrections to the method (errors against the thesis's own sources, no judgement): biodiesel-yield (biodiesel yield from oilseeds: oil content counted once); beef-carcase-yield (beef carcase-to-retail yield restored (0.705)). Compare with 2025-mirror for the effect of the corrections and with 2011-fixed for the like-for-like change since 2011 on the corrected method.
